name: Financial Assistance For Purchase Of Stationery To SC/ST/OBC/Minorities Students
benefit: **The amount of financial assistance is as followed:** 1. I to VIII class – Rs. 1000/- P.A. 1. IX to XII class – Rs. 2000/- P.A.
_eligibility_text: 1. Applicant should belong to SC/ST/OBC/Minorities and in support thereof they are required to upload SC/ST/OBC/Minorities certificate issued by concerned district office Delhi. 1. Application should be resident of Delhi and in support thereof he/she is required to upload a supporting document (Domicile). 1. The applicant should be studying in Class 1 to 12 in a government/aided/recognized public school. 1. Student may not opt any centrally sponsored scholarship scheme with the state funded scheme. 1. Have an annual family income not exceeding INR 2 lakh.
